tools.name: check_username_available
tools.description: Check whether a Kulhad page name is free. A page name is the last part of the address, as in kulhad.co/priya. Use this before suggesting a name to somebody setting up a page.

tools.name: start_signup
tools.description: Get a link that opens Kulhad sign-up with a page name already filled in. Hand it to the person setting up the page; they finish it themselves in a browser. This does not create an account and cannot. It marks the name as taken for check_username_available for fifteen minutes; it does not stop anyone

tools.name: get_my_profile
tools.description: Read the page details for the signed-in creator: name, page address, bio, links, language, plan, and any custom domain recorded on the account with its status (pending, active or disabled).

tools.name: get_page_settings
tools.description: Read the current appearance and behaviour settings for the page: theme, banner, suggested amounts, what is shown publicly, and the thank-you note.

tools.name: update_profile
tools.description: Change the creator's name, bio, page address, kind of page (person or organisation), page language, dashboard language, and the links on the page. Only the fields you pass change. Links replace the whole list, so pass every link that should stay. The bio keeps bold, italic, links and line breaks and

tools.name: update_page_appearance
tools.description: Change the page theme and the announcement banner across the top of it. Page themes, a custom theme colour (shown only when the theme is "custom"), your own banner colour, hiding the Kulhad badge, and a Google Analytics measurement ID are Premium. The measurement ID is stored as a page setting; Kulh

tools.name: update_page_behaviour
tools.description: Change what the page does: whether new supporters go up without approval, whether people may give without a name, whether the supporter count and total show, the three suggested amounts and their labels, the headline on the pay card, the note supporters see after paying, when stream alerts fire, and

tools.name: update_seo
tools.description: Set the title (up to 60 characters) and description (up to 160) in the page's HTML head, which search engines and link previews read. Part of Premium. A blank value goes back to the text Kulhad generates. This does not set an image and does not contact any search engine; it only changes what the pag

tools.name: set_saved_replies
tools.description: Replace the list of ready-made thank-you replies the creator picks from when approving a supporter. Part of Premium. At most 7, each up to 280 characters; blank replies and any containing a link or a flagged word are dropped and counted. Passing an empty list removes all of them.

tools.name: get_dashboard_summary
tools.description: The headline numbers from the creator dashboard: what came in this month against last, the all-time total, how many approved supports there have been, and how many are waiting to be approved.

tools.name: list_pending_supports
tools.description: List the supporters who have marked a payment as sent and are waiting for the creator to approve them. Kulhad cannot see a bank account, so this is what people say they sent, not what has been received. The creator checks their own bank app for the amount and the four-character code, then approves.

tools.name: list_supports
tools.description: List supporters, newest first, optionally narrowed by status or by date. Use this for history and for questions about a particular period; use list_pending_supports for the approval queue.

tools.name: get_support
tools.description: Read everything the creator can see about one supporter, by its id.

tools.name: approve_support
tools.description: Approve one supporter after the creator has found the payment in their own bank app. This cannot be undone. The supporter's name and amount then show on the creator's page and stream overlays and count toward totals and the active goal; if that fills the goal, the goal is marked complete and taken o

tools.name: reject_support
tools.description: Reject one supporter when the creator has checked their bank and the payment is not there. This cannot be undone. Any voice recording is deleted immediately; the record itself is cleared a week later. Nothing shows on the page and nothing is sent to the supporter.

tools.name: reply_to_supporter
tools.description: Write or replace the thank-you beside one supporter, up to 280 characters; links and flagged words are refused. It shows on the creator's page once the supporter is approved, and on the supporter's own receipt link in any case. Replaces the previous reply with no history and cannot be blanked. Does

tools.name: bulk_approve_supports
tools.description: Approve up to 100 waiting supporters at once after the creator has checked their bank. Part of Premium. This cannot be undone. Ids that are not waiting (already settled, not yet marked as sent, missing, or not this creator's) are skipped and counted. Same effects as approve_support; no reply is set.

tools.name: bulk_reject_supports
tools.description: Reject up to 100 waiting supporters at once. Part of Premium. This cannot be undone and any voice recordings are deleted immediately, so confirm the list with the creator first. Ids that are not waiting are skipped and counted.

tools.name: list_goals
tools.description: List every goal on the page, the active one first, with how much each has raised against its target.

tools.name: get_goal
tools.description: Read one goal in full, including its impact tiers and its progress notes.

tools.name: create_goal
tools.description: Create a goal with a title and a target in whole rupees. Unless active is false, it becomes the goal shown on the page and any other goal is put away, not deleted (set_active_goal brings one back). The free plan refuses while another goal is running, even with active false. Impact tiers are Premium.

tools.name: update_goal
tools.description: Change a goal's title, target, description, deadline or impact tiers. Only the fields you pass change, and each replaces the old value; impact replaces the whole list. Renaming changes the goal's web address, and the old address stops working with no redirect. Changing the target does not re-check w

tools.name: set_active_goal
tools.description: Make one goal the one shown on the page, or turn the current one off. The page shows a single goal at a time, so choosing one puts the others away without deleting anything. Reversible.

tools.name: delete_goal
tools.description: Delete a goal that has no approved support. This cannot be undone, and its cover image is deleted with it. Pending or rejected supports pinned to it lose the link. A goal with approved support stays in the history and can only be turned off.

tools.name: post_goal_update
tools.description: Add a short note, up to 280 characters, under a goal saying what the money did. Notes are kept newest first, at most 20 per goal, and show on the goal's page while the goal is active or complete. Free on every plan. Nobody is notified.

tools.name: delete_goal_update
tools.description: Remove one progress note from a goal by its position in the list, counting from zero with the newest first. This cannot be undone.

tools.name: list_upi_ids
tools.description: List the UPI IDs on the account, which are the addresses supporters pay into. The free plan keeps one of them active at a time.

tools.name: add_upi_id
tools.description: Add a UPI ID for supporters to pay into. Kulhad cannot check that an address is real or that it belongs to the creator, so tell them to send one rupee to it themselves and confirm it arrived before sharing the page. Duplicates are not checked. The free plan keeps one ID active at a time.

tools.name: update_upi_id
tools.description: Change the address or label of a UPI ID, switch it on or off, or mark the one-rupee test done. Changing the address clears the test, and from then on the new address is what supporters are quoted and what past supports display. At least one ID has to stay active. Switching off the default leaves the

tools.name: set_default_upi_id
tools.description: Make one active UPI ID the one supporters are shown first. The others stay on the account. This does not switch an ID on: an inactive ID made default is never quoted.

tools.name: remove_upi_id
tools.description: Remove a UPI ID from the account. The last one, and the only active one, cannot be removed. This cannot be undone, and past supports lose the link to it; switching it off instead keeps it.

tools.name: set_upi_rotation
tools.description: When on, active UPI IDs take turns being quoted so support spreads across them instead of landing in one account. Part of Premium.

tools.name: get_share_assets
tools.description: Get the page address, a QR code that opens the page (and a UPI payment QR for the counter when the counter QR is switched on), share images for stories and posts, and the printable sheets. Everything comes back as a link to open or download, not as an image.

tools.name: get_embed_code
tools.description: Get the HTML to put a support button, the pay card, or a live goal bar on the creator own website or blog. Returns the snippets to paste, not a rendered preview.

tools.name: get_stream_overlays
tools.description: Get the three overlay addresses to add to OBS or any streaming software as a browser source: a goal bar, a wall of recent supporters, and an alert that appears when someone gives. Includes the size each source should be and when alerts currently fire.

tools.name: send_test_alert
tools.description: Fire a test alert so the creator can see where it lands in OBS while setting up. It is not a real support: nothing is recorded, no goal moves and nobody is thanked. The overlay picks it up within about five seconds and it disappears after six.

tools.name: get_analytics
tools.description: Daily page views, approved supports and amounts for up to the last ninety days, thirty by default, with the rate at which visitors go on to support. Part of Premium. Comes from the nightly rollup, so today is not included and only days with activity are returned.

tools.name: get_wrapped
tools.description: Kulhad Wrapped for a year: how many people supported, the total, page views, the busiest month, and the largest single support. Free on every plan.

tools.name: get_support_sources
tools.description: Break approved support down by where it came from: the page itself, an embedded button, a QR code, the printed counter card, or a link tagged for WhatsApp, Instagram, YouTube or a standee. Use this to answer which channel is actually working.

tools.name: get_plan_and_billing
tools.description: Read which plan the account is on, when Premium runs to, whether it is set to end, and the past charges with links to their invoices. Read-only: nothing here starts, changes or cancels a subscription.

tools.name: get_custom_domain
tools.description: Read whether a custom domain is connected to the page, and what DNS record it needs. Part of Premium.

tools.name: set_custom_domain
tools.description: Record the domain the creator wants in front of their page and return the DNS record to add. Part of Premium. Replaces any domain already recorded, including a working one, which then stops serving until verify_custom_domain passes again, so confirm with the creator if a domain is already active. Th

tools.name: verify_custom_domain
tools.description: Look the domain up in public DNS and, if it points at Kulhad, switch the page to it; kulhad.co/<name> then redirects there. Part of Premium. Clears the same domain from any other account's unverified claim. Fails until the record has propagated, which is normal for the first few minutes.

tools.name: remove_custom_domain
tools.description: Disconnect the custom domain, so the page is served from its kulhad.co address again. Anything printed with the old domain on it stops working, so confirm with the creator first.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: update_seo, get_share_assets, get_embed_code · Private data: update_page_appearance, update_seo, approve_support, reject_support, get_custom_domain, set_custom_domain, verify_custom_domain · Public sink: post_goal_update, add_upi_id, get_share_assets, send_test_alert · Destructive: delete_goal, delete_goal_update, remove_upi_id, remove_custom_domain.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: update_seo, get_share_assets, get_embed_code · Private data: update_page_appearance, update_seo, approve_support, reject_support, get_custom_domain, set_custom_domain, verify_custom_domain · Public sink: post_goal_update, add_upi_id, get_share_assets, send_test_alert · Destructive: delete_goal, delete_goal_update, remove_upi_id, remove_custom_domain

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
